summary: Phase 24 assembles a REAL final MP4 from REAL PNG image sequences (testsrc + smptebars, 30x2 frames) and REAL WAV tracks with ffmpeg version. FrameSequenceNormalizer blocked all seven planted defect classes; the versioned mix plan (loudness-v1) was built with allowlisted ops and measured -15.0 LUFS / -11.296569 dBFS sample peak (policy -16.0 / -1.0). The EDL (57 frames = 2.0s - 0.1s fade) produced a final that passed ffprobe policy checks (h264 320x180 30fps 1.9s aac 48000 stereo) and a full decode; atomic publish, proxy/thumbnail/subtitle derived artifacts, same-manifest bit-exact rerun, different-profile semantic reproducibility and the invalidation matrix (BGM -> MIX_FINAL with frames reused, subtitle -> FINAL_ONLY remux, shot -> TIMELINE_FINAL) are all recorded. Test matrix: 341 passed, 0 failed; Ruff PASS.

backlog_completion.1_input_normalization_png_exr: DONE - FrameSequenceNormalizer inspects PNG/EXR sequences with fps/color metadata; missing/duplicate/gap/corrupt/wrong-dimension frames and wrong fps are BLOCKED before assembly (negative matrix in input_sequence_manifest.json proves all seven classes fail closed on REAL generated frames)
backlog_completion.2_edit_decision_list: DONE - EDL carries shot ordering, frame ranges, xfade transitions with frame-accurate offsets, audio offsets, subtitle track and final duration; planner rejects timeline math drift
backlog_completion.3_audio_normalization_and_mix: DONE - AudioMixNormalizer normalizes dialogue/SFX/BGM sample rate and channel layout (aformat 48000/stereo), mixes with amix and applies the versioned loudness/peak policy (loudnorm I=-16/TP=-1 + alimiter); REAL ebur128 measurement verifies the built mix within tolerance
backlog_completion.4_allowlisted_argv_no_shell: DONE - SequenceAssemblyPlanner emits argv LISTS built only from ALLOWED_FILTER_OPS; validate_argv rejects non-allowlisted filters, filter scripts and shell metacharacters; paths with spaces/Unicode/Windows separators pass as single argv elements
backlog_completion.5_staging_verify_atomic_publish: DONE - output lands in final_staging.mp4, ffprobe + full decode check gate the publish, AtomicPublisher publishes with os.replace and quarantines failed output; a verified deliverable is never overwritten (reuse path tested)
backlog_completion.6_derived_artifacts: DONE - proxy, thumbnail, subtitle and final MP4 are derived artifacts with own keys and SHA-256 in final_media_manifest.json
backlog_completion.7_exact_hash_audit_trail: DONE - input hashes (frames + tracks + subtitle), EDL/mix/profile hashes, ffmpeg version + tool hash, redacted argv, stdout/stderr and output hash recorded in ffmpeg_command_receipts/ and final_media_manifest.json
backlog_completion.8_reproducibility_audit: DONE - audit_manifest_runs: bit-exact REQUIRED only when tool + platform + profile are identical (proven by same-manifest rerun), otherwise manifest/technical-property equality (proven by a different-CRF rerun staying reproducible)
backlog_completion.9_invalidation_scope: DONE - AssemblyCoordinator: render shot change -> TIMELINE_FINAL (rebuild timeline+final); BGM change -> MIX_FINAL (mix+final rebuilt, visual frame hashes unchanged); subtitle change -> FINAL_ONLY remux with -c copy (no frame rerender); nothing changed -> verified deliverable reused
